approvers: Nobody, I decide alone; site manager's opinion
reason: We cover glazing with film and tape for next to nothing and I buy the cheapest thing that is good enough. About 19 euro per m2 is many times what we pay now, and the occasional damaged window is cheaper to replace than to protect.
objection: Why pay 19 euro per m2 when film and tape cost under 1 euro per m2? A 50% deposit up front on top of that makes it worse for my cash.
instead: Keep using cheap protection film and tape on the frames and absorb the odd replacement or cleaning cost.
would_change_my_mind: Hard proof from a Maltese contractor that it cuts my glazing damage claims and cleaning labour by more than the extra cost, at a price nearer 6 to 8 euro per m2 all-in with no deposit.
